items.title: 67256_Paul L. Howard oral history interview
items.q: I played all of Victor Herbert's numbers... 'Rider of the Waves,' is one of them, by Victor Herbert.

ctx.x: all through the piece, and I played all of Victor Herbert's numbers, trumpet solos -- cornet, it wasn't trumpet, it was cornet. Triple-tonguing, double-tonguing, triple-tonguing and all that, I did all of that. Those Italians had taught me how to do that. And you'd be surprised. When he took that thing out, and a fellow by the name of Buster Wilson was playing the piano, and started playing -- oh, Buster, Buster just started playing the blues, you know, just ordinary blues. Well, I played blues, they laughed at…
